## Story DD Coverage
- dd-1/2/3/4/5/6 (Steps 2/4/6 slice): All 6 loop protocol DDs for all 3 impl-plan touchpoints (Steps 2, 4, 6)

## Testing Mode
RED (bundled: create test + edit implementation-plan/SKILL.md — Gate 2; all 3 step blocks in one commit since same file)

## Files to Modify
- plugins/dso/skills/implementation-plan/SKILL.md (Edit — Steps 2/4/6 loop blocks)
- tests/scripts/test-loop-touchpoint-implplan-steps.sh (Create)

## Loop Block Requirements (×3 steps)
Each step gets an inline block: cycle declaration, oscillation-check hard gate on cycle >= 2, HALT-vs-REPLAN exclusivity, terminal REPLAN_ESCALATE:<step-specific-upstream>, mid-loop success exit, PROTOCOL_ERROR on invariant violation, trailing See: pointer to ab28 protocol doc.

## Non-Regression
After edit, re-run: bash tests/scripts/test-loop-touchpoint-preplanning-phase-e.sh → must PASS (task-1 non-regression)

## Acceptance Criteria
1. tests/scripts/test-loop-touchpoint-implplan-steps.sh exists and is executable
2. test 0 -ge 3 → passes
3. test 0 -ge 3 → passes
4. test 0 -ge 3 → passes
5. test 0 -ge 3 → passes
6. Run: bash tests/scripts/test-loop-touchpoint-implplan-steps.sh → PASS (all 6 DD scenarios × 3 touchpoints)
7. Run: bash tests/scripts/test-loop-touchpoint-preplanning-phase-e.sh → PASS (non-regression)
